scripts.env:check: node -e "console.log('Environment Check:'); console.log('DATABASE_URL:', process.env.DATABASE_URL ? '✅ configured' : '❌ missing'); console.log('CUSTOM_KEY:', process.env.CUSTOM_KEY ? '✅ configured' : '❌ missing'); console.log('NODE_ENV:', process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development');"
scripts.db:check: curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/health | jq '.database.healthy' || echo 'Health check failed'
scripts.setup:verify: curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/setup-env | jq '.status' || echo 'Setup verification failed'
